en.title: Devolver Digital Trolls GTA 6 Hype With Delete-to-Win Contest
en.summary: In a bold marketing move, Devolver Digital is challenging players to delete their Grand Theft Auto VI pre-loads for a chance to win a different game. This stunt leverages the immense anticipation surrounding Rockstar's upcoming title.
en.body:
The gaming world is, understandably, fixated on **Grand Theft Auto VI**. Rockstar Games' next installment is poised to be a monumental event, and its sheer gravity is already influencing marketing strategies across the industry. In a move that’s equal parts audacious and hilarious, indie publisher **Devolver Digital** has launched a unique giveaway tied directly to the **GTA VI** hype.

**Devolver Digital** is offering fans the chance to win a Steam key for their upcoming game, **Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed**, by participating in a rather unconventional challenge: deleting their **GTA VI** pre-load. To enter, players must share a video of themselves uninstalling the massive 212GB game, accompanied by a repost of **Devolver's** promotional message. While the deleted pre-load can, of course, be reinstalled, the act itself serves as a symbolic gesture of support for **Devolver's** counter-programming. For those who weren't planning on pre-ordering **GTA VI** but still wish to enter, **Devolver** has provided an alternative: send a video of yourself biting into a raw onion. The contest is a direct nod to the overwhelming spotlight **GTA VI** will command, especially with both games slated for release on November 19, 2026.

## A Bold Marketing Gambit

**Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed**, developed by **Doinksoft**, is set to launch on the same day as **Grand Theft Auto VI**. This timing is no accident. **Devolver** explicitly stated to Kotaku that this campaign is a form of "counter-programming," designed to capture attention amidst the inevitable **GTA VI** frenzy. The publisher acknowledges that while **GTA VI** will dominate the conversation, it's "not for everyone, or releasing on Steam the same day." This strategy aims to carve out a niche by embracing the absurdity of the situation. **Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed** itself has humble origins, initially prototyped as a retro-style 2D platformer for the Game Boy Color. Its current pricing is $5, with a launch discount bringing it down to $3.74.

## Community Reaction and Alternative Giveaways

The **Devolver Digital** contest has predictably sparked a mix of amusement and debate within the gaming community. Many appreciate the publisher's bold sense of humor and willingness to engage with the cultural moment. However, it's worth noting that other, more traditional giveaways are also circulating. One such initiative, detailed in a YouTube video, offers five copies of **GTA VI**: one $400 edition and four regular editions. To enter this separate giveaway, players must subscribe to the Instagram page @ZenBTG. Winners for that contest are scheduled to be announced on November 19, 2026, the same day **GTA VI** launches.

## What's Next

As November 19, 2026, draws closer, the gaming landscape will undoubtedly become even more saturated with **GTA VI**-related content and marketing. Publishers like **Devolver Digital** will continue to find creative ways to stand out, while fans eagerly await the release of Rockstar's highly anticipated title, alongside other potential contenders for awards like Game of the Year 2027.

content_raw: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 finally releases this week. The game looms so large that other companies are using it to market their own games, including Devolver Digital. The publisher has announced that people can enter for a chance to win their upcoming game, Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, by reposting the message below with a video of themselves deleting their GTA 6 pre-load. Of course, anyone who deletes their pre-load can install it again, though it might take some time given the game is 212GB . The lucky winners will get a Steam key for Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed , not a console code since the game's console plans haven't been confirmed yet, so that's something to keep in mind if you're taking part in this campaign. If you were never planning to buy GTA 6 but still want to enter the contest, you can send a video of yourself biting into a raw onion to Devolver. Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, priced at $5 (or $3.74 until launch), releases on November 19, which is the same day that GTA 6 comes out. Reslimed was originally prototyped as a retro-style 2D platformer for Game Boy Color and was pitched by developer Doinksoft before the GTA 6 conversation really ramped up. "There is no doubt GTA 6 will have the spotlight before, during, and after November 19, but it’s not for everyone, or releasing on Steam the same day, so we figure there’s a bit of counter-programming that may work in Volvy’s favor," Devolver told Kotaku . GTA 6 has reportedly already sold nearly 15 million copies and generated about $1.5 billion in revenue .
